hard.text: (Deviation Type Questions) The average weight of 10 students is increased by half a kg when one of the students weighting 51kg is replaced by a new student. Find the weight of the new student. (56, 75, 45, 66)

(Deviation type questions) The average height of a certain number of students in a group is 155.6cm. If 12 students having an average height of 150.5cm join the group and 7 students having an average height of 159cm leave the group, the average height of the students in the group will decrease by 34mm. What is the number of students, initially in the group.

hardest.text: The average runs scored by sumit in the first 3 matches is 122. In the 4th match, he scored some runs such that his average runs now become 130. In the 5th match, he scroed 14 less runs than those in the 4th match, and now the average of his last 4 matches becomes 164. The runs scored by Sumit in the 1st match is (9, 3, 5, 4)
